RETRACTION

Journal of Applied Field Metrology, 12 August 2026

The editors retract "Anomalous thermal signature in the RX-9 sensor array"
(Vol. 41, pp. 233-248, published 3 April 2026).

Following an institutional inquiry, the corresponding author confirmed that the
calibration constant applied in Table 2 was taken from an earlier, superseded
instrument profile. The reported signature does not survive re-analysis with the
correct constant.

All authors agree to the retraction. The article remains available, watermarked,
for the record.
